name: frontend
description: Frontend checks that the workflow start skill calls before implementation and before review (Svelte and React references that hand general rules to the official Svelte, Vercel React and React Router skills and the Next.js bundled docs, scripts that start the dev server on the item port and check added lines for debug code and dependency changes for the lockfile), the ui-design skill (DESIGN.md and Claude Code design canvas mockups, brought in by the start check when an item adds or redesigns a screen or needs DESIGN.md), the frontend-reviewer and design-reviewer agents for review, and the frontend-evaluator agent that verifies acceptance criteria in the browser.
